text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I'd better check my shift times.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Hmm, I've still got a few gaps around here. I should be able to fit in a one-time gig, at least. But then…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If I try to squeeze in more work, it means I'll have less time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Sigh. I wish I could just be energetic all the time without having to rest…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Ines Fujin is still a bit worn out from her races. I might have to rearrange her upcoming race schedule.
